description: Avatar window (PuppetView.svelte): loads the shown character, its image and its stored AI fill, listens for avatar:// events and reports ready through puppet_ready. Own title bar: drag and minimize (window API; these two accept a window label, so they could also drag or minimize the main window), close and dock into the main window (puppet_close, puppet_dock: both only act on the avatar window), the pin button (puppet_set_on_top, puppet_on_top: the saved always-on-top flag of the avatar window) and the opacity slider (puppet_set_opacity: tells the main window the new value). Nothing else: no other app command, no event emitting, no other window, app or plugin API (avatar.rs has a test pinning this list).
